q: The resource theory of coherence in one-shot quantum information identifies free states as:
opts: Incoherent states (diagonal in the computational basis)
States with maximum von Neumann entropy
exp: In the resource theory of coherence, free (resourceless) states are incoherent states—those diagonal in a fixed reference basis. Coherence is a resource and one-shot measures like robustness of coherence and one-shot coherence distillation/dilution quantify it.
